title: refactor(objectql): move count and rejectCredentialAggregation out of engine.ts into engine-count-aggregate.ts (#25522 cut 18)
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJNnGo3BD78wE9eBrmiBx5g)_ Part of #25522 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 6348891160 + 6441032442 ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：把 `engine.ts` 里「count / aggregate」区的两个方法体（`count` 计数门，和 `aggregate()` 的凭据字段聚合守卫 `rejectCredentialAggregation`）原样搬进新文件 `engine-count-aggregate.ts`；类上的方法签名、注释、位置不变，方法体换成转交。`count` 与留下的 `find` / `findOne` / `update` / `delete` / `aggregate` 共用的 7 个顶层 helper 原地加 `export`、由新文件导入（不复制）。`engine.ts` 21,835 → 21,762 行。 - **为什么改**：#25522 按缝拆分 `engine.ts` 的第 18 刀。重测的 seam 表里价最高的是删除级联区（−248），但派单把它和相邻两区排除（#26864 刚落地、#26871 正在那里开发）；其次是本区，定价 −71，高于 −30，且没有任何 open PR 触及。`aggregate` 本身留在原文件，因为 `packages/spec/liveness/query.json` 以 `engine.ts#aggregate` 登记它为生产者。 - **风险与回滚**：纯搬移，无行为变化；公开 `.d.ts` 六个文件与基线逐字节相同（含阳性对照）；运行期导出名单相同；构建产物只多出新文件一个区段，外部包导入顺序一条不差（新文件紧接 `./secret-fields.js` 导入）；一次性晚绑定探针在新旧两版构建产物上逐行一致。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine-count-aggregate.ts`（两个函数与 `CountAggregateHost`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 里两个转交桩、新导入行与 7 处原地 `export`。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-aggregate-filter.test.ts src/engine-middleware-operation-vocabulary.test.ts`，应见两个文件全部通过（聚合与计数门各自走到的测试）。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 Cut 18 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`), under the claim `6453372157`. Two bodies of the "count / aggregate" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-count-aggregate.ts`, behind `CountAggregateHost`: `count` (the counting door: alias fold, option refusal, filter-array lowering, search expansion, the operation context, token resolution, the middleware chain, the readable-ids boundary and the `find()` fallback) and `rejectCredentialAggregation` (`aggregate()`'s fail-closed guard against grouping or aggregating a `secret` / `password` / `internal: true` field). No behaviour changes. Every published declaration file is byte-identical to the base. #25522 stays open for the later cuts. Branch `claude/project-thread-axdp1m` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `1708115e2f`, which contains cut 17's merge (`cea0871ff2`, #26881) and #26864. ## What changes ### Why this area Re-measured on `1708115e2f` with cut 11's measure script and cut 14's price step (`price3.mjs`), both unchanged. `engine.ts` is 21,835 lines, 6,991 of them from the last 30 days (`git blame --since=2026-09-27T21:00Z`, clone deepened to 2026-09-21 first); `class ObjectQL` holds 326 members, 261 methods and accessors. Query-options erasure sites: 8 at base (lines 8408, 9648, 9894, 9958, 10290, 13570, 13869, 18499), none in this area. | price (net lines) | section | taken? | |---|---|---| | -248 | Delete cascade and reference walking | no: the order excludes it (#26864 landed there; #26871, branch `claude/project-thread-vdrn59`, is developing the predicate-delete walk across it) | | **-71 priced, -73 landed** | **count / aggregate** | **yes** (`count` 58 body lines, `rejectCredentialAggregation` 38; `aggregate` stays, named `engine.ts#aggregate` in `packages/spec/liveness/query.json`) | | -40 | Query lowering | runner-up: pays less | | -27 | Hook dispatch internals; `resolveFormulaRelated` | pays less; `resolveFormulaRelated` is a later cut, as the order says | | -21 or less | find / findOne, the rest | pays less | 36 of the 96 moved body lines are from the last 30 days. The two other excluded sections ("Dangling-reference and cascade inspection", "Referential integrity and master-detail resolution") price below -30 anyway. `registerMetadataCollections` was not considered (the order excludes it).

### The shape - The class keeps both methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. A body becomes one host literal of exactly the `CountAggregateHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 18]`, as cuts 8 and 10 to 17 did. Fields go as getters over a `readX` closure (`_registry`, `relatedSchemaOf`); methods go as late-bound closures (`resolveObjectName`, `expandSearchOnOptions`, `getDriver`, `resolveWhereTokens`, `executeWithMiddleware`, `buildDriverOptions`, `composeReadableIdsAtBoundary`, `find`), so a spy or double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches. No body assigns a field, so there is no setter (the interface docblock says only "getters" this time, not the cut-17 wording the seat flagged). - **Series limits.** `count` is public with a declared return type (`Promise`); `rejectCredentialAggregation` is private, so its `.d.ts` line is `private rejectCredentialAggregation;` either way. No moved body has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, a private-static read, a self-call to `insert` / `update` / `delete`, an `engine.ts#NAME` pointer or an ADR anchor paragraph of its own. `count` calls `composeReadableIdsAtBoundary` and `executeWithMiddleware`, which ADR-0139 names by path; they stay in the class and are reached through the host. - **Helpers, under the cut-14 seat ruling.** `count` reads seven top-level helpers, all also read by bodies that stay: `foldEngineOptionAliases`, `rejectUnknownEngineOptions`, `lowerWhereFilterArray`, `declaredDatetimeLowering` (`find`, `findOne`, `update`, `delete`, `aggregate`, and `judgeWhereAdmission` for the last two), `ENGINE_WHERE_SLOTS` (`update`, `delete`, `aggregate`), `ENGINE_COUNT_OPTION_KEYS` (`ENGINE_OPTION_KEY_SETS`) and `mergeReadContext` (`expandSearchOnOptions`, `find`, `findOne`, `aggregate`). Each gains `export` in place, byte for byte otherwise (leading docblocks included), and the module imports them as values from `./engine.js`; nothing is copied. `foldEngineOptionAliases` is also named by `packages/spec/liveness/query.json` as `engine.ts#foldEngineOptionAliases`, which still holds: it stays in `engine.ts`. Measured alone before the move (`dts-export-variant-cut18.sh`, base `engine.ts` plus the `export`, no move): each of the seven, and all seven together, leave all published declaration files byte-identical. `index.ts` and `core.ts` name their exports singly, so nothing new is published. - **The run-time cycle and the load order (measured).** The value import makes `engine.ts` and the module import each other. The module runs nothing at evaluation (declarations only). `rejectCredentialAggregation` was `engine.ts`'s only reader of `StandardErrorCode`, so that import line (`@objectstack/spec/api`, with its `[#22646]` comment) moves to the module verbatim. Two positions were built and compared (`cut18-place-builds.sh`, `bundlecmp.py`): importing the module where the `StandardErrorCode` line was (line 31) splits an extra `engine.ts` region and prints the `secret-fields.ts` region ahead of `engine-secret-internal-fields.ts` and the regions between, so the module evaluation order changes; importing it right after `./secret-fields.js` (the one other module it imports), as this PR does, leaves the order intact. Measured on the final head's bundles: with the `// src/engine.ts` markers set aside (10 at base and head), the `// src/...` region order equals the base's with one line added, `// src/engine-count-aggregate.ts` (`index.mjs` 99 to 100 regions, `core.mjs` 88 to 89, `index.js` 100 to 101, `core.js` 89 to 90). The external modules load in the same first-occurrence order, with the same statement counts: 113 and 96 `import` statements in the ESM bundles, 148 and 130 `require(` calls in the CJS bundles. The late-binding probe answers the same on base and head (Tests). - **Imports.** The module imports `EngineAggregateOptions`, `EngineCountOptions`, `QueryAST` (types, `@objectstack/spec/data`), `StandardErrorCode` (`@objectstack/spec/api`), `collectInternalReadFields` and `collectCredentialFields` (`./secret-fields.js`), the seven helpers (values) and `EngineReadOptions`, `ObjectQL`, `OperationContext` (types) from `./engine.js`. `engine.ts` loses the `StandardErrorCode` line; its `./secret-fields.js` import stays (`collectInternalReadFields` is still read there, and `collectCredentialFields` by the staying docblock's `{@link}`). - The module header names what moved, how the bodies reach the class, why `aggregate` stays, and how the helpers and the import position were handled. ### Net lines (the seat's rule) `engine.ts` goes from 21,835 to 21,762 lines, **net -73** (33 added, 106 removed). The module is 202 lines. The diff against `origin/main` is 341 changed lines over 2 files (+235 / -106). ### Readers of the moved lines - No census, ADR anchor, docs row or test key names a moved member by `engine.ts` path. Searched: `engine.ts#count`, `engine.ts#rejectCredentialAggregation` and `engine.ts … count` spellings, plus every `scripts/**` file that reads `engine.ts` (durability baselines, engine-double contract, logger-receiver detach, single-authz resolver, startup-registry verdict, widget-option census, type-check coverage, erasure baseline, tenant-audit and isSystem censuses): none names them. The prose mentions found (`CHANGELOG.md` entries, a `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` docblock, `service-analytics/src/api-exposure-door.ts`) name `rejectCredentialAggregation` by behaviour, not by path. - `packages/spec/liveness/query.json` names `engine.ts#aggregate`, `engine.ts#foldEngineOptionAliases` and `engine.ts#ENGINE_QUERY_SLOTS`: all three stay in `engine.ts`, so nothing under `packages/spec` changes. - `engine-middleware-operation-vocabulary.test.ts` reads the `OperationContext['operation']` union out of `engine.ts`, where it stays; the test passes. The bodies call no `canReadObject(` (core's `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` is unchanged), no `referenceTargetOf(`, no `isFederatedObject` / `resolveTenantFieldName`, and read no `isSystem` (`system-context.mdx` is unchanged; its census is green). They hold no `query-options/no-any-erasure` site and no tenant-audit untyped receiver. - **Read-seam census (the cut-21 trap of #25467).** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` at base and head: identical once line numbers are masked (164 lines: 48 durability seams and 88 read seams); `count`'s driver read sits outside any catch, so it is no seam. - **No ADR anchor paragraph describes a moved body** (the `engine.ts` entry is the transaction-seam paragraph), so the module needs no anchor entry of its own. - **Decision-letter count:** `check-adr-anchors` at base `1708115e2f` (clean detached worktree): **1,897** decision-letter citations on the anchored surface, 60,009 resolving citations across 8,416 files. At head: **1,896**, 60,009 across 8,417. The one letter that leaves the anchored surface is `[ADR-0139 D2]` in `count`'s body (the executor-boundary comment), which moved verbatim into the unanchored module; cut 15 disclosed the same kind of drop (`[ADR-0139 D6]`, 1,881 to 1,880). No anchor paragraph was written for it: none of the `engine.ts` entry's text describes `count`, and `docs/adr/**` is outside this claim. ## Why #25522 splits `engine.ts` one seam at a time so that a change to one area reads, reviews and conflicts as that area alone. After cut 17, the highest-paying section no open PR touches is "count / aggregate". Nothing about what the engine does changes. ## Tests No test is added and none is edited: the move is proved by identity, not by new behaviour, and no test reads a moved line by path.

(d) Raw diff: 0 lines in every file. (e) After the head build, the full `turbo run build` (116 of 116 tasks, the dependents' DTS builds included) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck` ran on the head `dist/`: exit 0 each. - Premises re-checked at this head: (P2) `packages/objectql/package.json` `exports` names `./dist/index.*` and `./dist/core.*` only; (P3) `git grep -n -E 'objectql/dist|driver-sql/dist' -- scripts package.json`: 0 hits. - **Each in-place export alone, before the move** (`dts-export-variant-cut18.sh`, base `engine.ts` with only `export` added): `none`, each of the seven alone, and all seven together print the same `util-BaJGwxSm.d.ts`, `index.d.ts` `6a16c278b5ac…` and `core.d.ts` `9f22dc909731…`. **Positive control.** On this head, one `sed` dropped `private` from ` private rejectCredentialAggregation(` (a moved member's stub; anchor count 1 to 0, replacement count 0 to 1; `engine.ts` blob `c16b33857e02` to `b97293c87022`) and rebuilt (`posctl18.sh`, build exit 0). The chunk is renamed `util-CKT4sa10` and now publishes `rejectCredentialAggregation(object: string, query: EngineAggregateOptions): void;` (line 11266, where the head prints `private rejectCredentialAggregation;`); its normalised sha256 is `32d9098f1fd316a6b8ffb7e5a40a0da99017775007bf862aed09cf9ed0c83ae5` ≠ `c43cb8b1…`, its declared-surface digest `4c6ca61214efff63…` ≠ `b264bade9e7d8157…` (the `declare class ObjectQL` statement named as the one changed), and the raw `core.d.ts` (`6548856dfe13…`) and `index.d.ts` (`7bff7db9b23e…`) change with the chunk name. `index.d.ts` normalises EQUAL under the control (an entry only re-exports), which is why every declaration file is read. The restore leg put the blob back to `c16b33857e02` (`git diff HEAD` empty), and the full build that followed produced an `@objectstack/objectql` `dist/` whose six declaration files and two ESM bundles compare equal to the head build.
AST compare (move-only) `astcmp.mjs` (TypeScript compiler API, comments and whitespace ignored, tokens compared) on base `engine.ts` against head `engine.ts` plus the module: - The two moved bodies are **SAME** against base `1708115e2f` (parameters, return type, `async`, body tokens, and every body line equal after one level of indent): `count` 296 tokens / 58 lines, `rejectCredentialAggregation` 296 / 38. - `class ObjectQL`: 326 of 326 members kept, in the same order; 324 byte-identical, and the 2 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature identical. - Top level: 227 of 236 base statements byte-identical. The other 9 (`exportcmp.mjs`): the `@objectstack/spec/api` `StandardErrorCode` import, moved verbatim to the module; the seven helpers, exported in place with statement and leading docblock otherwise identical; and the class. The head adds one statement: the module import.
